title: Review
failed: Agentry could not read the review from {{host}}.

request.title: Ask for a review
request.intro: Type the logins of the people to ask, separated by spaces or commas. People already on the list are left as they are.
request.label: Logins
request.failed: Could not ask for the review
request.nobody: Nobody was added. Check that the login exists on {{host}}.

draft.title: Your review
draft.empty: No comments yet. Press a line in the changes to leave one; they are all sent together, as a single review.
draft.discardBody_one: The {{count}} note will be deleted. Nothing has been sent.
draft.discardBody_other: The {{count}} notes will be deleted. Nothing has been sent.

host.githubOnly: Approving or asking for changes is done on GitHub.
host.own: {{host}} does not let you approve or ask for changes on your own {{noun}}. You can comment and ask others for a review.
host.pending: You have a review on {{host}} that is not sent. Send it or discard it there first.

partly.text: Some comments were saved as drafts on {{host}} and the sending of the {{noun}} stopped.
partly.discarded: The saved comments were discarded; your draft is still here
partly.failedPublish: Could not publish the saved comments
partly.failedDiscard: Could not discard the saved comments
partly.gone: Nothing saved is left on {{host}}: discard to send again.

submit.title: Submit your review
submit.commentHelp: Comment sends all the comments at once.
submit.approveHelp: Approve also approves commit {{sha}}: if new commits arrive first, GitLab refuses it.
submit.summaryPlaceholder: What you think of the {{noun}} as a whole
submit.nothing: There are no notes to send: write a summary, or approve.

reason.own-change-request: {{host}} does not let you review your own {{noun}}.
reason.pending-review-exists: You already have a review on {{host}} that is not sent.
reason.line-not-in-diff: A note is on a line that is not in the {{noun}}'s changes: {{detail}}
reason.write-unconfirmed: {{host}} did not confirm the review. Look at the {{noun}} before sending it again.
reason.head-moved: New commits arrived. Reload the page and check them first.

moved.text: The {{noun}} moved from {{from}} to {{to}} after you wrote these notes. Sending now posts them on {{to}}: read what changed first if you have not.
moved.unknown: The {{noun}} has new commits after you wrote these notes, and its head could not be read now. Reload the page and check them first.

composer.label: Note
composer.private: Only you see it until you submit the review.
